notes: v666 - IMPORTANT FIX: the app could stop loading live data permanently after you changed which share TYPES you download. There is a safety check that refuses a live list much smaller than the last one, so a truncated download can never replace your good market data. Two things were wrong with it. The remembered size only ever went UP, so once it had seen a big list including options, warrants and other instruments, it could never come back down. And it compared the wrong two numbers: the type filter runs first, cutting the list to shares only, and that smaller number was then measured against a figure recorded when everything was included. Tick 'shares only' and every correct list failed the check, forever, with the retries failing identically. The remembered size is now kept separately for each type-filter setting, so like is compared with like, and it can fall as well as rise. A single short list is still refused. Three in a row that agree within 2% are accepted as the real size, because that is the market telling you something rather than a fault. A basic floor still catches a badly truncated download even on a filter setting the app has not seen before. The message now says what is happening and that a recent change to your download types is the likely cause. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
